C1245.title: Yuhuan Court Warns That Gift Card Benefit Packages May Disguise Online Lending
C1245.summary: In October 2024, People's Daily Online republished a People's Court Daily legal commentary about a business model identified during a case heard by the Yuhuan Municipal People's Court in Zhejiang. A small online platform sold gift card benefit packages under a buy-now-pay-later arrangement, combining cards with membership benefits or goods. The judge viewed the model as disguised online lending that could operate outside financial supervision.
